Canonical rule today: trailing slash, lowercase. User research: 14 interviews say buyers compare plans before reading features and can't find security docs. Migration authority: Head of Web, Tomas Berg, approves the redirect map. Locales: en and de. Propose the page model, navigation, URL rules, and redirect map.
